Subject: MAP draft — Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Hey Patricia / Alex — great to meet you both on the call earlier. Per our discussion, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding and procurement milestones so we can hit your target production date. High level: procurement setup (Ariba/Coupa), vendor paperwork (Redwood vendor form + W-9), bank details for payment, PO issuance and kick-off.

Attached is a first-pass MAP draft (MAP_draft_v2.xlsx) and our vendor onboarding instruction doc (Vendor_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf). Key asks from your side are below. Happy to sync again if you want to walk through this with Procurement.

Proposed milestones (summary):
- 1) Procurement intake & vendor profile created in Ariba/Coupa — owner: Acme Procurement (Alex/Jillian) — target: 2026-09-20 — dependency: budget approval
- 2) Redwood vendor questionnaire + Redwood W-9 returned — owner: Acme legal/finance (Patricia) — target: 2026-09-17 — dependency: internal sign-off
- 3) Banking details & remittance setup (ACH) — owner: Acme finance (Patricia) — target: 2026-09-17
- 4) PO issued to Redwood (Net30) / Contract countersigned — owner: Acme Procurement + Redwood Legal (Marissa) — target: 2026-09-24 — dependency: legal review
- 5) Vendor onboarding completed in Ariba/Coupa + Redwood invoice routing configured — owner: Redwood ops (Camila) & Acme Procurement — target: 2026-09-27
- 6) Initial integration/SSO + test calls — owner: Redwood engineering & Acme IT — target: 2026-09-30 — dependency: onboarding completion

Immediate asks for this week:
- Please confirm your Procurement contact who will create the vendor record in Ariba/Coupa and the expected intake form they need.
- Patricia: can you share the W-9 and bank remit details (or confirm you prefer Redwood to provide our vendor packet first)?
- If you prefer, we can send the MAP as a shared Google Sheet and update milestones live.

Target close date (go-live): 2026-09-30

Thanks — I'll wait for the Procurement owner and we can move the milestones into a live MAP.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
